text:
matt: Anyone else seeing gnode attach failures in us-west3? GPU capacity looks fine but attach latency spikes and IOPS max out quickly
olivia: Yep noticed during the midnight batch window. attach latency ~3-4s then timeouts for some pods :/
cheng: Diving in — quick hint: is this the hotstripe pool (hot blocks) that recently got rebalanced?
matt: yes hotstripe. scrub backlog was running earlier, maybe cleaner+scrub overlap. IOPS on local nvme skyrocketed
olivia: ps — `iostat -x 1 5` on affected host shows %util ~99 and await > 20ms
cheng: grabbing nvme perf counters, sample output:
```
nvme0n1: iops=118000, avg_queue=52, write_ms=18.3, read_ms=14.7
scrubber: threads=12, backlog=4200, reclaim_rate=850/s
cleaner: active=4, delete_rate=1200/s
```
infra-bot: [alert] nvme_io_saturation us-west3-hotstripe pool_high_iops (fired)
sre-oncall: Re-route attach traffic? We can try temporary pool isolation and divert new GPU attaches to us-west2 until scrub window completes
matt: We can't move long-running jobs, but new attaches can be diverted. What's the impact on capacity/cost?
olivia: Diverting to us-west2 increases cross-region egress for some workloads. Cost hit estimated ~2-3% for next 6h if we shift 20% of attaches. Also latency bump for eu customers routing through us-west2.
cheng: Short-term mitigation I suggest:
- pause scrub on hotstripe (feature-flag: scrub.suspend=hotstripe)
- reduce cleaner concurrency to 2
- enable attach fallback routing for new requests to us-west2/us-east1
- throttle local write bursts via iops_cgroup (limit 60k)
I'll open a rollout PR now.
sre-oncall: +1 to changing cleaner concurrency and fallback routing. Pausing scrub needs sign-off from storage owners (may expose wear backlog).
matt: I'm OK with pause for 2 hours if we avoid corruption risk. Any evidence of metadata errors?
cheng: Quick health check across nodes shows no metadata checksum errors. SMART shows rising wear but within thresholds. Corruption risk low for now.
olivia: If we throttle iops at cgroup level, GPUs will queue and some user-facing timeouts might increase — need to update SLO docs and notify product.
sre-oncall: I'll file an incident note and ping product. Also scheduling maintenance window 02:00 UTC to re-run scrub with lower concurrency.
cheng: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/storage/+/I-2403 (sets scrub.suspend flag + cleaner concurrency change + iops cgroup)
infra-bot: deploy started: canary 1/5 nodes us-west3-hotstripe at 1758884500
matt: monitoring. If IOPS drops and attach latency recovers, we can roll rest. Fingers crossed :crossed_fingers:
olivia: adding postmortem checklist: - root cause (overlap scrub + cleaner on hotstripe) - tuning defaults - automatic attach fallback thresholds - alert severity adjustments
cheng: I'll follow up with a wear-rate forecast and a plan to spread hot blocks more aggressively so this doesn't repeat. Thanks all.
